secondReadOnlyPass.finding: No substantive production security defect established. The only unbounded operation is the explicitly admitted non-cancellable rename; polling resources are invocation-owned and stopped at terminal disposition. Fixed-worker auxiliary wrapper fields are ignored without input-to-worker-code authority.

surfaces.trust: Untrusted operator path spelling and untrusted supplied bytes; native identities come only from fixed helper
surfaces.parser: validateRelativeFile/validateAbsoluteRoot/resolveContained; Win32 Open-Chain + Read-Identity; acquisition root and file identity ledger
surfaces.finding: ASCII relative grammar; reserved/device/ADS/UNC/traversal guards; ordinary local roots; all ancestors opened with reparse-point semantics, same native volume, disk type, exact final paths, file nlink1, write/delete sharing denied for file reads; same handle yields identity and bytes; all seven identity fields and reopened paths rechecked.
surfaces.tests: Native symlink/junction/hardlink/type/path negatives; actual two-phase root identity replacement; closed response volume substitution and actual distinct-volume symlink escape refusal.
surfaces.limitation: Actual distinct-volume namespace escape refused at earlier reparse boundary; native volumeSerial mismatch branch is not claimed. Frozen private immutable-root precondition excludes privileged concurrent namespace attacker.

surfaces.trust: Private byte transport from a fixed executable/script; no returned executable authority
surfaces.parser: Closed request/response records, exact canonical body, length-prefixed one-frame plus EOF, session/sequence/operation echo, chunked canonical base64
surfaces.finding: Unknown fields/versions/operations, duplicate/noncanonical data, malformed base64, extra/truncated frames, replay/session/sequence mismatch reject. Request/response prefix-inclusive caps65536/16777216. Helper error response contains no raw body/path.
surfaces.tests: Independent JS wire corpus and actual fixed Windows helper request corpus; +1 frame caps.
surfaces.limitation: Raw direct helper calls in run-1/run-2 are protocol observations, not supervised product deadline certification. Every native helper process exit is0 for a well-formed ERROR frame; receipt mapped exit is the public machine-error mapping.

surfaces.trust: Trusted installed system executable and exact packaged helper; caller environment untrusted
surfaces.parser: Internally constructed executable/argv/options; validateLaunch refuses Node preload/config flags
surfaces.finding: Fixed C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe, NoLogo/NoProfile/NonInteractive/ExecutionPolicy Bypass/File fixed packaged script, shell false, windowsHide true. Only SystemRoot/WINDIR passed. No PATH/PATHEXT/policy/script/module-path selection or persistent execution-policy command.
surfaces.tests: Fixed launch exact-array assertions, environment poison, invalid execArgv, actual supervised fixed transport.
surfaces.limitation: Refusal checks do not undo malicious code loaded before trusted process launch.

surfaces.trust: Fixed packaged worker is trusted code; its copied bounded byte input is untrusted; returned message defensively admitted
surfaces.parser: One worker result, closed inner value shape/digests/bytes, duplicate message refusal, fixed URL and empty env/execArgv, module hook allowlist
surfaces.finding: Malformed/oversized result, wrong status, duplicate message, unrecognized error and late/cancelled completion fail. Caller has no public evaluator/worker URL option. fs/process/network dynamic imports and fetch/WebSocket denied in actual worker policy tests.
surfaces.tests: Worker supervisor doubles plus eight actual worker policy denial cases.
surfaces.limitation: Outer OK message auxiliary fields are not checked for exact keys, but ignored; fixed worker generates the closed wrapper and caller cannot select or author worker code. No trust escalation or substantive product defect established.

surfaces.trust: Supervisor owns exactly one helper lease or one worker thread; native helper owns positively identified console host
surfaces.parser: runOwned active-owner exclusion; helper sequence begin/complete/helperExited and worker begin/end; helper transport EOF/close proof
surfaces.finding: Second role cannot launch while active; one worker per call; helper exits and streams close before transition. Valid response implies earlier helper-native console detachment/owned conhost handle termination proof. No response after startup failure means cleanup is unconfirmed and no next phase.
surfaces.tests: Helper/helper and helper/worker overlap refusal, actual one-helper quiescence; actual two-helper identity case.
surfaces.limitation: Full multi-invocation process observation/RSS and MO1306 slot3 timing remain Phase3A scope; first raw UNC engineering timeout has no retained PID/console cleanup proof.

surfaces.trust: Environment never semantic authority; source content remains untrusted supplier bytes
surfaces.parser: Closed import allowlist, sanitized helper/worker environment, fixed diagnostic serialization
surfaces.finding: No production network library/import/call or provider/Git process found. Sentinel proxy/credentials/PATH/home/PowerShell overrides do not alter fixed helper selection. Product error records do not expose raw exception text. Private helper protocol necessarily returns acquired input bytes; those bytes are not public CLI diagnostics.
surfaces.tests: Poisoned helper parent, actual worker import denials, output sentinel rejection and fixed diagnostic sentinel test.
surfaces.limitation: No OS-wide egress capture/sandbox claim. Synthetic sentinel fixture files are intentionally retained and are not real secrets.

surfaces.trust: Private WeakMap-branded sequence, capability and token; no public authority parameter
surfaces.parser: consumePublicationInspection root/single-claim binding and terminal sequence; token state lookup
surfaces.finding: Unbranded/foreign/wrong-root/reused capabilities and tokens fail. Single-use stage/finalize guards; session/sequence and exact chain stability bind root and pending. Public callers cannot supply native callback/evaluator/token.
surfaces.tests: Independent foreign token/capability, wrong root, reuse, second-stage/finalize, replay and identity mutation controls.
surfaces.limitation: Private engineering seams require trusted test orchestration and do not establish native authority by themselves.

surfaces.trust: Fixed owned output namespace under immutable-root assumption
surfaces.parser: PRE_SUBMISSION/COMMIT_IN_PROGRESS/COMMITTED/FAILED plus detached bytes and exact native slot9 chain
surfaces.finding: Exactly one rename after last checkpoint with no async gap. Submission is not commit. Pending byte tamper and pre-existing final refuse. Timeout/cancellation before admission prevents rename. After admission flags remain operational, exact rename settles, final retained, transport refuses OUTPUT21. No rollback, recursive cleanup or second mutation.
surfaces.tests: Actual finite libuv-queued Windows rename under synthetic native-inspection frames; one rename, no early terminal result, final retained, both post-admission flags, second finalize refusal.
surfaces.limitation: An admitted non-cancellable rename may stay pending indefinitely. One bounded post-settlement read-only deadline does not solve availability. No retry storm/background server/cross-run scheduler exists.

surfaces.trust: Output stream is operational transport, never authority
surfaces.parser: Complete LF summary, bounded serialized errors, output stream close/error/deadline handling
surfaces.finding: Unsolicited worker bytes fail; >4096 bytes fails RESOURCE_LIMIT. Raw helper stderr is counted, not surfaced. Diagnostics use fixed error catalog/reference enums. Machine result is complete or rejected; no normative array truncation.
surfaces.tests: Worker secret-output refusal,4097-byte refusal; parent owns complete output catalog/boundary corpus.
surfaces.limitation: Partially offered stdout after a committed result remains operational failure; no rollback is claimed.

limitations.reason: Existing distinct NTFS volume GUID root was observed read-only, then targeted through one owned directory symlink. Actual fixed helper refused at earlier reparse policy; no target contents/read/list/write, no mount/drive creation. Native volumeSerial mismatch branch is not claimed; closed-response volume substitution remains separately tested.
Private immutable roots are required. No hostile-OS sandbox or kernel no-replace guarantee.
Static closed import/Win32 authority and poisoned proxy/credential environment only; no OS network capture.
3A owns resource characterization; no hard OS aggregate RSS sandbox.
One submitted rename may remain unresolved indefinitely; no retries, further mutation, polling service or cross-run task added.
